selectionPolicy.basis: 250 additional completed pairs toward 750, in ten 25-pair releases. Ordered selection is a research queue, not an assertion that 250 references qualify. Assessment included living canonical/regional breeds, exact varieties, crossbreeds and historical types. Historical reconstruction, known synonyms, ambiguous parent substitution and existing holds remain excluded. Every exact identity, source chain, original and researched claim must qualify before any generation call. Genuine blocks require append-only evidence and the next eligible reserve; no attempt, packet, held identity or draft counts toward completion.
